evidence.review_requirement: Requires review before sharing. This is a private operator export of saved records, not a public-safe or publication-approved artifact.
limitations: Recorded review and check evidence only. No live HEAD, workspace, remote, authorization or current pull-request checks were performed while producing this export.
Planning completion is not task completion: a completed cycle records decisions, not delivered work.
A recorded pull request describes delivery, not merge. Published is not merged.
Audit acceptance is a recommendation. Audit cycles never create an execution queue, so an accepted audit proposal has no linked task by design.
Saved session routes are requested routes. Runtime model identity is not independently reported here.
Costs, delivery time and any replay timeline are not inferred from these records.
Zero or multiple task matches are preserved as recorded. No single task is selected on the caller's behalf.
Free text carried here (proposal problem, benefit, scope and evidence, and code-review findings) is model-authored and still requires manual review before sharing.
gaps: Every record in this walkthrough is fabricated to explain the workflow. No real model run, code change or pull request is represented.

proposals.title: Keep the final line of an export
proposals.problem: In this synthetic notes app, exporting a file without a trailing newline drops the final note.
proposals.benefit: Keep every saved note in the exported file, including a one-line file.
proposals.scope: Flush the remaining buffer in src/export.rs and add regression cases for empty, one-line and multi-line files.
evidence: Synthetic source: src/export.rs — buffered export loop
Synthetic regression: tests/export.rs — final line without newline
proposals.final_reason: A reproducible data-loss case with a small fix and specific regression coverage is worth implementing.

reviewer_verdicts.reason: Synthetic assessment: The final buffer is never emitted at EOF. This is a concrete correctness problem with a bounded fix.
Synthetic assessment: Cover both trailing-newline and no-trailing-newline inputs so the fix cannot duplicate the last note.

gaps: PR #12 is a fabricated delivery reference. No live GitHub URL is supplied.

proposals.title: Measure before adding a cache
proposals.problem: The synthetic search path rebuilds its index, but the proposal includes no measurements at realistic project sizes.
proposals.benefit: Caching might reduce repeated search latency if index construction is the bottleneck.
proposals.scope: Cache the search index and invalidate it when notes change.
evidence: Missing evidence: a representative benchmark and invalidation requirements
proposals.final_reason: Gather representative timings and define invalidation behavior before deciding whether a cache is worthwhile.

reviewer_verdicts.reason: Synthetic assessment: A cache could help, but first measure index construction separately from disk reads.
Synthetic assessment: Stale search results are a correctness risk. Defer implementation until the benchmark and invalidation contract exist.

proposals.title: A failing check stops delivery
proposals.problem: In this synthetic sync queue, transient write errors drop pending work instead of allowing a bounded retry.
proposals.benefit: Preserve queued work through a transient failure and retry without duplicating successful writes.
proposals.scope: Add bounded retry handling and test pending-result preservation in src/sync.rs.
evidence: Synthetic source: src/sync.rs — pending write queue
Synthetic regression: tests/sync_retry.rs — interrupted write followed by retry
proposals.final_reason: The proposal addresses a concrete failure mode. Implementation still needs clean review and passing checks.

reviewer_verdicts.reason: Synthetic assessment: Preserving pending work is useful; test both retry success and exhausted attempts.
Synthetic assessment: Accept the bounded fix, with explicit coverage that a new attempt cannot overwrite an unresolved result.
